149std::vector<int> toBin(int number, UINT nBits = 0)
150{
151 // Takes an integer and returns a std::vector containing
152 // its binary representation
153
154 UINT i; // iterate over each bit
155 int bit; // temp storage of each bit
156 std::vector<int> bits; // return vector
157 while (number > 0)
158 {
159 bit = number & 1;
160 number = number >> 1;
161 bits.push_back(bit);
162 }
163 if (nBits > bits.size())
164 {
165 for (i = bits.size(); i < nBits; i++)
166 {
167 bits.push_back(0);
168 }
169 }
170 return bits;
171}

182int toInt(std::vector<int> v)
183{
184 // Takes a std::vector containing the binary representation
185 // of an integer and returns that integer
186
187 int counter = 0; // increasing iterator
188 int result = 0;
189 for (UINT i = 0; i < v.size(); i++)
190 {
191 result = result + v[i] * twoPow(counter);
192 counter++;
193 }
194 return result;
195}

399public:
400 tangent(float dx, float dy) {
401 init(dx, dy);
402 }
403 void init(float dx, float dy){
404 slope = 0;
405 err = false;
406 if (dx == 0 && dy == 0){
407 //tolog("Incorrect tangent!\n");
408 err = true;
409 }
410 if (dx < 0 && dy <= 0) {
411 quadrant = 1;
412 slope = dy / dx;
413 } else if (dx >= 0 && dy < 0) {
414 quadrant = 2;
415 slope = -dx / dy;
416 } else if (dx > 0 && dy >= 0) {
417 quadrant = 3;
418 slope = dy / dx;
419 } else {
420 quadrant = 4;
421 slope = -dx / dy;
422 }
423 }
424 void init(point p1, point p2){
425 float dx = p2.x - p1.x;
426 float dy = p2.y - p1.y;
427 slope = 0;
428 err = false;
429 init(dx, dy);
430 if (slope != slope){
431 tolog(_L_ + "Incorrect tangent: \n" + p1.croack() + p2.croack());
432 err = true;
433 }
434 }
435 tangent(){}
436 tangent(point p1, point p2){
437 init(p1, p2);
438 }
439 bool error(){
440 return err;
441 }
442 UINT getQuadrant(){
443 return quadrant;
444 }
445 float getSlope(){
446 return slope;
447 }
448 point transformPoint(point p, float r){
449 point result;
450 float sq = slope * slope;
451 float dy = r * sqrt(1/(1+sq));
452 float dx = slope * dy;
453 if (quadrant == 1){
454 result.x = p.x - dy;
455 result.y = p.y - dx;
456 }
457 else if (quadrant == 2){
458 result.x = p.x + dx;
459 result.y = p.y - dy;
460 }
461 else if (quadrant == 3){
462 result.x = p.x + dy;
463 result.y = p.y + dx;
464 }
465 else if (quadrant == 4){
466 result.x = p.x - dx;
467 result.y = p.y + dy;
468 }
469 return result;
470 }
471 //void operator=(tangent t) {
472 // quadrant = t.quadrant;
473 // slope = t.slope;
474 //}
475 void rotate(tangent t) {
476 if (t.quadrant == quadrant && t.slope == slope){
477 slope = 0;
478 quadrant = 1;
479 return;
480 }
481 float tslope = t.slope;
482 float s = slope;
483 if (t.slope > 0) {
484 tslope = 1 / t.slope;
485 } else {
486 quadrant++;
487 }
488 quadrant += 4 - t.quadrant;
489 if ((s * tslope) == 1) {
490 slope = 0;
491 quadrant++;
492 } else {
493 slope = (s + tslope) / (1 - s * tslope);
494 if (slope < 0) {
495 quadrant++;
496 slope = -1 / slope;
497 }
498 }
499 quadrant = (quadrant - 1) % 4 + 1;
500 }

502 tangent bisect(tangent t){
503 tangent t1 = *this;
504 tangent t2 = t;
505 tangent d = t1 - t2;
506 tangent h(-1, 1);
507 tangent half(-1, 0);
508 UINT qdiff = d.quadrant - 1;
509 for (UINT i = 0; i < qdiff; i++){
510 half.rotate(h);
511 }
512 float s = d.slope;
513 float s1 = 0;
514 if (s > 0){
515 s1 = (sqrt(1 + s*s) - 1) / s;
516 }
517 tangent rest = tangent(-1, 0);
518 rest.slope = s1;
519 tangent r = half + rest;
520 tangent result = r + t1;
521 return result;
522 }
523
524 tangent leftIntermediate(tangent t){
525 tangent t1 = *this;
526 tangent t2 = t;
527 tangent rv(1, 0);
528 tangent tt = t2 + rv;
529 tangent b = t1.bisect(tt);
530 return b;
531 }
532
533 tangent operator-(tangent t){
534 tangent t1 = *this;
535 tangent t2 = t;
536 t2.rotate(t1);
537 tangent result = t2;
538 return result;
539 }
540
541 tangent operator+(tangent t){
542 tangent result(1, 1);
543 result.quadrant = quadrant;
544 result.quadrant += t.quadrant - 1;
545 float s = slope;
546 float tslope = t.slope;
547 if ((s * tslope) == 1) {
548 result.slope = 0;
549 result.quadrant++;
550 }
551 else{
552 result.slope = (s + tslope) / (1 - s * tslope);
553 }
554 if (result.slope < 0) {
555 result.quadrant++;
556 result.slope = -1 / result.slope;
557 }
558 result.quadrant = (result.quadrant - 1) % 4 + 1;
559 return result;
560 }
561
562 bool operator<(tangent t2) {
563 if (quadrant > t2.quadrant) {
564 return false;
565 } else if (quadrant < t2.quadrant) {
566 return true;
567 } else if (slope < t2.slope) {
568 return true;
569 } else {
570 return false;
571 }
572 }
573 bool operator==(tangent t2){
574 if (slope == t2.slope && quadrant == t2.quadrant){
575 return true;
576 }
577 return false;
578 }
579 bool operator!=(tangent t2){
580 return !(*this == t2);
581 }
582 bool operator<=(tangent t2){
583 if (*this < t2 || *this == t2){
584 return true;
585 }
586 return false;
587 }
588 std::string croack() {
589 std::ostringstream r;
590 r << "Slope: " << slope << "\tQuadrant: " << quadrant << std::endl;
591 return r.str();
592 }

838 point place(scale s, point m){
839 point r;
840 scale tempScale;
841 tempScale.initScale();
842 float offset;
843 float Scale;
844 if (s.ratio() <= ratio())
845 {
846 offset = s.xSpan() - s.ySpan() / ratio();
847 offset /= 2;
848 tempScale.setMinX(offset + s.minX());
849 tempScale.setMaxX(s.maxX() - offset);
850 tempScale.setMinY(s.minY());
851 tempScale.setMaxY(s.maxY());
852 }
853 else
854 {
855 offset = s.ySpan() - ratio() * s.xSpan();
856 offset /= 2;
857 tempScale.setMinX(s.minX());
858 tempScale.setMaxX(s.maxX());
859 tempScale.setMinY(offset + s.minY());
860 tempScale.setMaxY(s.maxY() - offset);
861 }
862 r.x = m.x - minX();
863 r.y = m.y - minY();
864 r.x /= xSpan();
865 r.y /= ySpan();
866 r.x *= tempScale.xSpan();
867 r.y *= tempScale.ySpan();
868 r.x += tempScale.minX();
869 r.y += tempScale.minY();
870 Scale = tempScale.xSpan() / xSpan();
871 r.radius = Scale * m.radius;
872 return r;
873 }

875 void addToScale(point p){
876 if (clear){
877 x = p.x - p.radius;
878 X = p.x + p.radius;
879 y = p.y - p.radius;
880 Y = p.y + p.radius;
881 clear = false;
882 }
883 else{
884 float possib[4] = {
885 p.x - p.radius,
886 p.x + p.radius,
887 p.y - p.radius,
888 p.y + p.radius
889 };
890 for (UINT i = 0; i < 2; i++){
891 if (possib[i] < x){
892 x = possib[i];
893 }
894 else if (possib[i] > X){
895 X = possib[i];
896 }
897 }
898 for (UINT i = 2; i < 4; i++){
899 if (possib[i] < y){
900 y = possib[i];
901 }
902 else if (possib[i] > Y){
903 Y = possib[i];
904 }
905 }
906 }
907 }

1021 if (close)
1022 {
1023 rx = v[v.size()-1].x - v[0].x;
1024 ry = v[v.size()-1].y - v[0].y;
1025 result += sqrt(rx * rx + ry * ry);
1026 }
1027 return result;
1028}

1104class binMap
1105{
1106
1107 int ngroups;
1108 std::vector<std::vector<int> > column;
1109 std::vector<std::vector<std::vector<int> > > row;
1110
1111 signed int firstUnmatched1(std::vector<int> v)
1112 {
1113 /***********************************************************
1114
1115 Returns an integer with the position of the first
1116 unmatched 1. If none is found, the function
1117 returns -1.
1118
1119 @v is the input std::vector to be searched for unmatched 1s
1120
1121 ***********************************************************/
1122
1123 signed int counter = 0;
1124 UINT i;
1125 for (i = 0; i < v.size(); i++)
1126 {
1127
1128 if (v[i] == 1)
1129 {
1130 counter++;
1131 if (counter > 0)
1132 return i;
1133 }
1134 else
1135 {
1136 counter--;
1137 }
1138 }
1139 return -1; // no unmatched @which
1140 }
1141
1142 signed int firstUnmatched0(std::vector<int> v)
1143 {
1144 /***********************************************************
1145
1146 Returns an integer with the position of the first
1147 unmatched 0. If none is found, the function
1148 returns -1.
1149
1150 @v is the input std::vector to be searched for unmatched 0s
1151
1152 ***********************************************************/
1153
1154 int counter;
1155 UINT i, j;
1156 bool ismatched = false;
1157 if (v.size() > 0){
1158 for (i = 0; i < v.size() - 1; i++)
1159 {
1160 counter = 0;
1161 if (v[i] == 0)
1162 {
1163 ismatched = false;
1164 for (j = i + 1; j < v.size(); j++)
1165 {
1166 if (v[j] == 0)
1167 {
1168 counter++;
1169 }
1170 else
1171 {
1172 counter--;
1173 }
1174 if (counter < 0)
1175 ismatched = true;
1176 }
1177 if (!ismatched)
1178 return i;
1179 }
1180 }
1181 if (v[v.size() - 1] == 0)
1182 return (v.size()-1);
1183 }
1184 return -1; // no unmatched @which
1185 }
1186 std::vector<std::vector<int> > getBranches(std::vector<int> v)
1187 {
1188 /***********************************************************
1189
1190 Returns a std::vector containing all of the branches derived
1191 from the input vector. These are obtained by changing to
1192 1 each 0 to the right of the last 1 if the resulting
1193 std::vector has no unmatched 1s. If there are no branches,
1194 the return std::vector is empty.
1195
1196 @v input binary vector
1197
1198 ***********************************************************/
1199
1200 UINT i;
1201 int last1=0;
1202 std::vector<int> tempV;
1203 std::vector<std::vector<int> > result;
1204 for (i = 0; i < v.size(); i++)
1205 {// Get last 1
1206 if (v[i]==1)
1207 last1 = i;
1208 }
1209 for (i = last1 + 1; i < v.size(); i++)
1210 {
1211 tempV = v;
1212 tempV[i] = 1;
1213 if (firstUnmatched1(tempV) == -1)
1214 {
1215 result.push_back(tempV);
1216 }
1217 }
1218 return result;
1219 }
1220
1221 void fillColumn(std::vector<int> v)
1222 {
1223 std::vector<int> result;
1224 int position = 0;
1225 result = v;
1226 position = firstUnmatched0(result);
1227 column.push_back(v);
1228 while (position != -1)
1229 {
1230 result[position] = 1;
1231 column.push_back(result);
1232 position = firstUnmatched0(result);
1233 }
1234 row.push_back(column);
1235 column.clear();
1236 }
1237
1238 void fillRow(std::vector<std::vector<int> > c)
1239 {
1240 UINT i;
1241 std::vector<std::vector<int> > tempc;
1242 for (i = 0; i < c.size(); i++)
1243 {
1244 fillColumn(c[i]);
1245 tempc = getBranches(c[i]);
1246 fillRow(tempc);
1247 }
1248 }
1249
1250public:
1251
1252 friend class borderLine;
1253
1254 binMap(int n)
1255 {
1256 std::vector<int> currentV;
1257 std::vector<std::vector<int> > currentC;
1258 ngroups = n;
1259 currentV = toBin(0, n);
1260 fillColumn(currentV);
1261 currentC = getBranches(currentV);
1262 fillRow(currentC);
1263 }
1264 void textOut()
1265 {
1266 UINT i, j, k;
1267 for (i = 0; i < row.size(); i++)
1268 {
1269 for (j = 0; j < row[i].size(); j++)
1270 {
1271 for (k = 0; k < row[i][j].size(); k++)
1272 {
1273 std::cout << row[i][j][k];
1274 }
1275 std::cout << " ";
1276 }
1277 std::cout << std::endl;
1278 }
1279 }
1280};

1292class decider{
1293 bool finish;
1294 bool canFinish;
1295 bool first;
1296 UINT cyclesWithoutImprovement;
1297 UINT finishAfter;
1298 float bestCompactness;
1299 UINT nAvg;
1300 UINT counter;
1301 UINT ncycles;
1302 UINT mincycles;
1303 float totalCompactness;
1304 float lastCompactness;
1305 float bestUntie;
1306 float wRoom;
1307 bool keep;
1308public:
1309 void setConstants(UINT numberForAverage, UINT numberForStability, float wiggleRoom = 1, UINT minNumberOfCycles = 0){
1310 finish = false;
1311 canFinish = false;
1312 cyclesWithoutImprovement = 0;
1313 nAvg = numberForAverage;
1314 finishAfter = numberForStability;
1315 counter = 0;
1316 totalCompactness = 0;
1317 first = true;
1318 keep = false;
1319 wRoom = wiggleRoom;
1320 mincycles = minNumberOfCycles;
1321 }
1322 void init(){
1323 finish = false;
1324 canFinish = false;
1325 first = true;
1326 cyclesWithoutImprovement = 0;
1327 counter = 0;
1328 ncycles = 0;
1329 totalCompactness = 0;
1330 lastCompactness = 0;
1331 }
1332 void setCanFinish(){
1333 canFinish = true;
1334 if (finishAfter == 0){
1335 finish = true;
1336 }
1337 }
1338 bool keepState(){
1339 return keep;
1340 }
1341 void add(float comp){
1342 keep = false;
1343 ncycles++;
1344 if (first){
1345 first = false;
1346 counter++;
1347 bestCompactness = comp;
1348 lastCompactness = comp;
1349 }
1350 if (canFinish){
1351 if (finishAfter == 0){
1352 finish = true;
1353 }
1354 if (comp < (bestCompactness)){
1355 bestCompactness = comp;
1356 keep = true;
1357 cyclesWithoutImprovement = 0;
1358 }
1359 else{
1360 cyclesWithoutImprovement++;
1361 if (cyclesWithoutImprovement > finishAfter){
1362 finish = true;
1363 }
1364 }
1365 }
1366 else{
1367 totalCompactness += comp;
1368 counter++;
1369 if (counter > nAvg){
1370 float newAvg = totalCompactness / ((float)(nAvg));
1371 if (newAvg > (lastCompactness / wRoom) && ncycles > mincycles){
1372 canFinish = true;
1373 }
1374 counter = 1;
1375 totalCompactness = 0;
1376 lastCompactness = newAvg;
1377 }
1378 }
1379 }
1380 UINT viewCounter(){
1381 return counter;
1382 }
1383 float viewLastComp(){
1384 return lastCompactness;
1385 }
1386 UINT viewCanFinish(){
1387 return (UINT) canFinish;
1388 }
1389 UINT viewCyclesWithoutImprovement(){
1390 return cyclesWithoutImprovement;
1391 }
1392
1393 bool finished(){
1394 bool result = finish;
1395 return result;
1396 }
1397
1398};

1758 point place(scale s, point m)
1759 {
1760 point r;
1761 scale tempScale;
1762 tempScale.initScale();
1763 float offset;
1764 float Scale;
1765 if (s.ratio() <= internalScale.ratio())
1766 {
1767 offset = s.xSpan() - s.ySpan() / internalScale.ratio();
1768 offset /= 2;
1769 tempScale.setMinX(offset + s.minX());
1770 tempScale.setMaxX(s.maxX() - offset);
1771 tempScale.setMinY(s.minY());
1772 tempScale.setMaxY(s.maxY());
1773 }
1774 else
1775 {
1776 offset = s.ySpan() - internalScale.ratio() * s.xSpan();
1777 offset /= 2;
1778 tempScale.setMinX(s.minX());
1779 tempScale.setMaxX(s.maxX());
1780 tempScale.setMinY(offset + s.minY());
1781 tempScale.setMaxY(s.maxY() - offset);
1782 }
1783 r.x = m.x - internalScale.minX();
1784 r.y = m.y - internalScale.minY();
1785 r.x /= internalScale.xSpan();
1786 r.y /= internalScale.ySpan();
1787 r.x *= tempScale.xSpan();
1788 r.y *= tempScale.ySpan();
1789 r.x += tempScale.minX();
1790 r.y += tempScale.minY();
1791 Scale = tempScale.xSpan() / internalScale.xSpan();
1792 r.radius = Scale * m.radius;
1793 return r;
1794 }

1822 minRat = 0.02 * minCoord;

1831 if (rat < 1 && rat > 0){
1832 trad = tr / rat;

1835 trad = tr;

1896 void randomizeCircles(){
1897 UINT gstep = 1;
1898 UINT gridSize = twoPow(ngroups >> 1);
1899 if ((ngroups & 1) > 0){ // Odd number of groups
1900 gridSize = gridSize << 1;
1901 gstep = 2;
1902 }
1903
1904 //std::cout << "gridSize: " << gridSize << "\n";
1905 float xstep = internalScale.xSpan() / ((gridSize + 1));
1906 float ystep = xstep; //internalScale.ySpan() / (gridSize + 1);
1907 //std::cout << "xStep: " << internalScale.xSpan() << "\n";
1908 //std::cout << "yStep: " << ystep << "\n";
1909 std::vector<UINT> order;
1910 for (UINT i = 0; i < circles.size(); i++){
1911 order.push_back(i);
1912 }
1913 std::random_device rd;
1914 if (!fromSignature) seed = rd();
1915 std::mt19937 g(seed);
1916 shuffle(order.begin(), order.end(), g);
1917 UINT sy = 0; UINT sx = 0;
1918 for (UINT i = 0; i < circles.size(); i++){
1919 float cx = (sx + 0.5) * xstep + internalScale.minX();
1920 float cy = (sy + 0.5) * ystep + internalScale.minY();
1921 sx += gstep;
1922 if (sx > gridSize){
1923 sy++;
1924 sx = 0;
1925 }
1926 circles[order[i]].x = cx;
1927 circles[order[i]].y = cy;
1928 }
1929

1933 void setPoints(binMap b, UINT ngroup)
1934 {
1935 int i, counter;
1936 int cstart; //placement of first and last point
1937 //depending on ngroup
1938 point cpoint; //point storage
1939 point fpoint; //first point
1940 int height;
1941 int width;
1942 int omyheight; //offset
1943 int myheight;
1944 int isOne;
1945 height = b.row[0].size();
1946 // First point
1947 if (ngroup < (ngroups - 1))
1948 {
1949 cstart = b.ngroups - ngroup - 2;
1950 }
1951 else
1952 {
1953 cstart = ngroups - 1;
1954 }
1955 fpoint.x = -6 * (1 + cstart);
1956 fpoint.y = 6 * (height + 1 + cstart);
1957 internalScale.addToScale(fpoint);
1958 p.push_back(fpoint);
1959 // Variable points
1960 width = b.row.size();
1961 for (i = 0; i < width; i++)
1962 {
1963 cpoint.x = 6 * i - 2;
1964 // mygroup
1965 myheight = b.row[i].size();
1966 omyheight = (height - myheight) / 2; // the diff is always even
1967 isOne = 1;
1968 counter = myheight; // counts the row
1969 if (b.row[i][counter -1][ngroup] == 1)
1970 {
1971 while (isOne == 1)
1972 {
1973 counter--;
1974 if (counter >= 0)
1975 {
1976 isOne = b.row[i][counter][ngroup];
1977 }
1978 else
1979 {
1980 isOne = 0;
1981 }
1982 }
1983 }
1984 else
1985 {
1986 counter--;
1987 }
1988 cpoint.y = 6 * (omyheight + counter) - 3;
1989 internalScale.addToScale(cpoint);
1990 p.push_back(cpoint);
1991 cpoint.x = 6 * i + 2;
1992 internalScale.addToScale(cpoint);
1993 p.push_back(cpoint);
1994 // add circles
1995 }
1996 //last point
1997 cpoint.x = 6 * (width + 1 + cstart);
1998 cpoint.y = 6 * (height + 1 + cstart);
1999 cpoint.mass = POINT_MASS;
2000 internalScale.addToScale(cpoint);
2001 p.push_back(cpoint);
2002 initOlds();

2048 point eqforce(point &p0, point &p1, float kattr = 5e-2f)
2049 {
2050 point result;
2051 float radius;
2052 float dx, dy;
2053 float fatt;
2054 float d;
2055 radius = 1.0 * (p0.radius + p1.radius);
2056 float maxrad = p0.radius;
2057 if (p1.radius > maxrad) maxrad = p1.radius;
2058 //radius *= 1.2;
2059 dx = p1.x - p0.x;
2060 dy = p1.y - p0.y;
2061 d = distance(p0.x, p0.y, p1.x, p1.y);
2062 fatt = 0;
2063 if (d > maxrad) fatt = blSettings.sk * kattr * (d - radius);
2064 if (d < maxrad) fatt = -fatt;
2065 fatt /= twoPow(ngroups);
2066 result.fx = dx * fatt;
2067 result.fy = dy * fatt;
2068 p0.fx += result.fx;
2069 p1.fx -= result.fx;
2070 p0.fy += result.fy;
2071 p1.fy -= result.fy;
2072 return result;
2073 }
2074
2075 point selforce(point &p0, point &p1, float kattr = 5e-3f, float radiusFactor = 0)
2076 {
2077 if (kattr == 0){
2078 kattr = 5e-3f;
2079 }
2080 if (p1.radius == 0 || p0.radius == 0){
2081 return p0;
2082 }
2083 float repulsion = blSettings.sk * kattr * 5;
2084 point result;
2085 float factor = (float) getRelationships(p0.n, p1.n) + 1;
2086 float radius = radiusFactor * (p0.radius + p1.radius);
2087 //radius *= 1.2;
2088 float dx = p1.x - p0.x;
2089 float dy = p1.y - p0.y;
2090 float d = distance(p0.x, p0.y, p1.x, p1.y);
2091 float fatt = 0;
2092 if (d > radius) fatt = (factor*factor) * blSettings.sk * kattr * (d-radius) - repulsion;
2093 //if (d < radius) fatt = -blSettings.sk * kattr * (d - radius);
2094 result.fx = dx * fatt/d;
2095 result.fy = dy * fatt/d;
2096 potential += fatt;
2097 p0.fx += result.fx;
2098 p1.fx -= result.fx;
2099 p0.fy += result.fy;
2100 p1.fy -= result.fy;
2101 return result;
2102 }
2103
2104 point selforce2(point &p0, point &p1, float kattr = 5e-4f)
2105 {
2106 if (kattr == 0){
2107 kattr = 5e-4f;
2108 }
2109 if (p1.radius == 0 || p0.radius == 0){
2110 return p0;
2111 }
2112 float repulsion = -kattr;
2113 point result;
2114 //float factor = (float) getRelationships(p0.n, p1.n);
2115 float radius = p0.radius + p1.radius + 4 * blSettings.margin;
2116 //radius *= 1.2;
2117 float dx = p1.x - p0.x;
2118 float dy = p1.y - p0.y;
2119 float d = distance(p0.x, p0.y, p1.x, p1.y);
2120 if (d == 0){
2121 d = 0.01;
2122 }
2123 float fatt = 0;
2124 if (d > radius) fatt = blSettings.sk * kattr * (d-radius) - repulsion;

2152 void embellishTopology(bool logit = false){
2153 tangent lft(0, -1);
2154 tangent rgh(0, 1);
2155 for (UINT k = 0; k < circles.size(); k++){
2156 circles[k].flags = unsetFlag(circles[k].flags, USED);
2157 }
2158 for (UINT i = 0; i < bl.size(); i++){
2159 bool again = true;
2160 while (again){
2161 again = false;
2162 std::vector<point> newbl;
2163 for (UINT j = 0; j < bl[i].size(); j++){
2164 if (!again){
2165 point nxt = bl[i][nextPoint(i, j)];
2166 point current = bl[i][j];
2167 newbl.push_back(current);
2168 float dsq3 = sqDistance(current, nxt);
2169 if (dsq3 > 0){
2170 float sq3 = sqrt(dsq3);
2171 UINT fcirc = 0;
2172 for (UINT k = fcirc; k < circles.size(); k++){
2173 point c = circles[k];
2174 if (c.radius > 0){
2175 float lrad = maxRad();
2176 if (!again && ((c.flags & USED) == 0)){
2177 bool inside = (c.n & twoPow(i)) > 0 ? true : false;
2178 float dsq1 = sqDistance(c, current);
2179 float dsq2 = sqDistance(c, nxt);
2180 float rsq = c.radius * c.radius;
2181 if (dsq3 > dsq1 && dsq3 > dsq2 && dsq1 > rsq && dsq2 > rsq){
2182 float h = sqrt(-(dsq1 * dsq1 + dsq2 * dsq2 + dsq3 * dsq3) +
2183 2 * dsq1 * dsq2 + 2 * dsq1 * dsq3 + 2 * dsq2 * dsq3) / (2 * sq3);
2184 //tolog(toString(__LINE__) + "\n" + toString(h) + "\t" + toString(dsq1) + "\t" + toString(dsq2) + "\t" + toString(dsq3) + "\t" + toString(sq3) + "\n");
2185 if (h > 0 && h < c.radius){
2186 again = true;
2187 fcirc = k + 1;
2188 tangent tp(nxt.x - current.x, nxt.y - current.y);
2189 float t = sqrt(lrad * lrad - h * h);
2190 float d1 = sqrt(dsq1 - h * h);
2191 float x1 = d1 - t;
2192 point pst1 = tp.transformPoint(current, x1);
2193 pst1.flags = setFlag(pst1.flags, DO_NOT_EMBELLISH);
2194 pst1.flags = setFlag(pst1.flags, DELME);
2195 pst1.n = k;
2196 point pst2 = tp.transformPoint(current, d1 + t) ;
2197 pst2.flags = setFlag(pst2.flags, DO_NOT_EMBELLISH);
2198 pst2.flags = setFlag(pst2.flags, DELME);
2199 pst2.n = k;
2200 newbl.push_back(pst1);
2201 tangent tr = tp + rgh;
2202 //tolog(toString(__LINE__) + "\n" + "Outside: \n" + tp.croack() + tr.croack());
2203 if (inside || (!inside && ((c.flags & USED) > 0))){
2204 tr = tp + lft;
2205 //tolog(toString(__LINE__) + "\n" + "Inside: \n" + tp.croack() + tr.croack());
2206 }
2207 c.flags = setFlag(c.flags, USED);
2208 point newp = tr.transformPoint(c, lrad);
2209 newp.flags = setFlag(newp.flags, DO_NOT_EMBELLISH);
2210 newp.flags = setFlag(newp.flags, DELME);
2211 newp.n = k;
2212 newbl.push_back(newp);
2213 newbl.push_back(pst2);
2214 // Close the bl for the next cycle
2215 for (UINT l = j+1; l < bl[i].size(); l++){
2216 newbl.push_back(bl[i][l]);
2217 }
2218 }
2219 }
2220 }
2221 }
2222 }
2223 }
2224 }
2225 }
2226 bl[i].clear();
2227 bl[i] = newbl;
2228 for (UINT k = 0; k < circles.size(); k++){
2229 circles[k].flags = unsetFlag(circles[k].flags, USED);
2230 }
2231 }
2232 }
2233 /* */
2234 }

2530 float getArea(){

2532 for (UINT i = 0; i < bl.size(); i++){
2533 for (UINT j = 0; j < bl[i].size(); j++){
2534 point p1 = bl[i][j];

2541 neg = -1;

2560 float compactness(){

2563 if (circles[i].radius > 0){
2564 for (UINT j = i + 1; j < circles.size(); j++){
2565 if (circles[j].radius > 0){
2566 UINT n = getRelationships(i, j);
2567 if (n > 0){
2568 float sqd = sqDistance(circles[i], circles[j]);
2569 result += log(sqd) + log(n);
2570 }

2573 }
2574 }

2578 UINT nextLeftmostPoint(UINT ngroup, UINT n1, UINT n2){
2579 point anchor = circles[n1];
2580 if (n1 == n2){
2581 anchor.x -= 1;
2582 }
2583 groupIterator git(circles, ngroup, n2);
2584 git.nxt();
2585 bool first = true;
2586 ccwangle best(anchor, circles[n2], anchor);
2587 UINT result = git.val();
2588 while (!git.isFinished()){
2589 UINT n3 = git.val();
2590 if (n3 != n2){
2591 ccwangle test(anchor, circles[n2], circles[n3]);
2592 if (first || best < test){
2593 first = false;
2594 best = test;
2595 result = n3;
2596 }
2597 }
2598 git.nxt();
2599 }
2600 return result;
2601 }

3022 std::vector<UINT> sampleUINT(std::vector<UINT> from, UINT n, std::mt19937 *gen){
3023 UINT nc = from.size() - 1;
3024 std::vector<UINT> cp = from;
3025 std::vector<UINT> result;
3026 std::set<UINT> offsets;
3027 for (UINT i = 0; i < n; i++){
3028 std::uniform_int_distribution<UINT> distrib(0, nc);
3029 UINT ni = distrib(*gen);
3030 std::set<UINT>::iterator it;
3031 for (it = offsets.begin(); it != offsets.end(); it++){
3032 UINT v = *it;
3033 if (v <= ni){
3034 ni++;
3035 }
3036 }
3037 offsets.insert(ni);
3038 result.push_back(from[ni]);
3039 nc--;
3040 }
3041 return result;
3042 }

3056 float MHCompact(){
3057 UINT nstep = 2; // Number of circles exchanged in each step
3058 UINT maxSteps = 100000;
3059 std::random_device rd; // Will be used to obtain a seed for the random number engine
3060 std::mt19937 gen(rd()); // Standard mersenne_twister_engine seeded with rd()
3061 std::uniform_real_distribution<float> alpha(0.0, 1.0);
3062 UINT cyclesWithoutImprovement = 0;
3063 float bestCompactness = compactness();
3064 std::vector<UINT> existingCircles = ncircles();
3065 UINT counter = 0;
3066 while (cyclesWithoutImprovement < 1000 && counter < maxSteps){
3067 std::vector<UINT> exch = sampleUINT(existingCircles, nstep, &gen);
3068 UINT ci = exch[0];
3069 UINT cj = exch[1];
3070 tolog("Exchanging " + toString(ci) + " with " + toString(cj) + "\n");
3071 swapCoords(ci, cj);
3072 float newCompactness = compactness();
3073 tolog("Old comp: " + toString(bestCompactness) + "\tNew comp: " + toString(newCompactness) + "\n");
3074 if (newCompactness < bestCompactness){
3075 cyclesWithoutImprovement = 0;
3076 bestCompactness = newCompactness;
3077 }
3078 else{
3079 float decd = alpha(gen);
3080 float rtio = bestCompactness / newCompactness;
3081 tolog("Decider: " + toString(decd) + ", " + "Ration: " + toString(rtio) + "\n");
3082 if (decd > rtio){
3083 swapCoords(ci, cj);
3084 tolog("Bailed\n");
3085 }
3086 cyclesWithoutImprovement++;
3087 }
3088 counter++;
3089 }
3090 return bestCompactness;
3091 }
3092
3093 float MHCrosses(){
3094 UINT nstep = 2; // Number of circles exchanged in each step
3095 UINT maxSteps = 10000;
3096 std::random_device rd; // Will be used to obtain a seed for the random number engine
3097 std::mt19937 gen(rd()); // Standard mersenne_twister_engine seeded with rd()
3098 std::uniform_real_distribution<float> alpha(0.0, 1.0);
3099 UINT cyclesWithoutImprovement = 0;
3100 fixTopology();
3101 float bestCrossings = countCrossings();
3102 std::vector<UINT> existingCircles = ncircles();
3103 UINT counter = 0;
3104 while (cyclesWithoutImprovement < 500 && counter < maxSteps){
3105 std::vector<UINT> exch = sampleUINT(existingCircles, nstep, &gen);
3106 UINT ci = exch[0];
3107 UINT cj = exch[1];
3108 tolog("Exchanging " + toString(ci) + " with " + toString(cj) + "\n");
3109 swapCoords(ci, cj);
3110 fixTopology();
3111 if (checkTopol()){
3112 swapCoords(ci, cj);
3113 }
3114 else{
3115 float newCrossings = countCrossings();
3116 tolog("Old cross: " + toString(bestCrossings) + "\tNew cross: " + toString(newCrossings) + "\n");
3117 if (newCrossings < bestCrossings){
3118 cyclesWithoutImprovement = 0;
3119 bestCrossings = newCrossings;
3120 }
3121 else{
3122 float decd = alpha(gen);
3123 float rtio = bestCrossings / newCrossings;
3124 tolog("Decider: " + toString(decd) + ", " + "Ration: " + toString(rtio) + "\n");
3125 if (decd > rtio){
3126 swapCoords(ci, cj);
3127 tolog("Bailed\n");
3128 }
3129 cyclesWithoutImprovement++;
3130 }
3131 counter++;
3132 }
3133 }
3134 return bestCrossings;
3135 }

3146 void resetOptimize(){

3152 UINT furthestPoint(){
3153 UINT result = 0;
3154 float best = 0;
3155 bool first = true;
3156 for (UINT i = 0; i < circles.size(); i++){
3157 if (circles[i].radius > 0){
3158 float val = 0;
3159 if ((circles[i].flags & DO_NOT_OPTIMIZE) == 0){
3160 for (UINT j = 0; j < circles.size(); j++){
3161 if (i != j){
3162 UINT rel = getRelationships(i, j);
3163 if (rel > 0){
3164 float dsq = sqDistance(circles[i], circles[j]);
3165 val += log(rel) + log(dsq);
3166 //tolog(toString(val) + "\n");
3167 }
3168 }
3169 }
3170 if ((first) || (val > best)){
3171 result = i;
3172 best = val;
3173 first = false;
3174 }
3175 }
3176 }
3177 }
3178 //tolog(_L_ + circles[result].croack());
3179 circles[result].flags = setFlag(circles[result].flags, DO_NOT_OPTIMIZE);
3180 return result;
3181 }
3182
3190 UINT crossestPoint(){
3191 UINT result = 0;
3192 UINT crossest = 0;
3193 UINT mask = (1 << (ngroups)) - 1;
3194 bool first = true;
3195 for (UINT i = 1; i < circles.size(); i++){
3196 if (circles[i].radius > 0 && !(circles[i].flags & DO_NOT_OPTIMIZE)){
3197 UINT val = ones(circles[i].n & mask);
3198 //tolog(toString(circles[i].n) + ": " + toString(val) + "\n");
3199 if (first || val < crossest){
3200 result = i;
3201 crossest = val;
3202 first = false;
3203 }
3204 }
3205 }
3206 circles[result].flags = setFlag(circles[result].flags, DO_NOT_OPTIMIZE);
3207 //tolog("CNext: " + toString(circles[result].n) + "\n");
3208 return result;
3209 }

3215 float outCompactness(optimizationStep *opt, UINT (borderLine::*chooseCandidate)(),
3216 float (borderLine::*countFunct)(), float (borderLine::*untieFunct)(),
3217 bool logit = false){
3218 float untie = (this->*untieFunct)();
3219 displayFloat("BEST", opt->getBestCompactness());
3220 if (opt->hasEnded()){
3221 opt->startCycle();
3222 opt->setCandidate((this->*chooseCandidate)());
3223 UINT n = opt->getCandidate();
3224 tolog("Next candidate: " + toString(circles[n].n) + "\n");
3225 if (n == 0){
3226 opt->endCycle();
3227 resetOptimize();
3228 opt->startCycle();
3229 }
3230 //std::cout << circles[n].n << std::endl;
3231 }
3232 else{
3233 UINT candidate = opt->getCandidate();
3234 displayUINT("CANDIDATE", candidate);
3235 if (candidate > 0){
3236 UINT i = opt->getCounter();
3237 if (i != candidate && circles[i].radius > 0){
3238 swapCoords(i, candidate);
3239 //tolog("Checking " + toString(circles[i].n) + " with " + toString(opt->getBestCompactness()) + "\n");
3240 //std::cout << circles[i].n << ", ";
3241 fixTopology();
3242 //writeSVG("starting.svg");
3243 if (checkTopol()){
3244 tolog("Undo on checkTopol\n");
3245 swapCoords(i, candidate);
3246 }
3247 else{
3248 float newComp = (this->*countFunct)();
3249 if (newComp < opt->getBestCompactness()){
3250 opt->setBestCompactness(newComp);
3251 tolog("Swapping " + toString(i) + " with " + toString(candidate) + " -> " + toString(newComp) + "\n");
3252 //std::cout << "Swapping " << i << " with " << candidate << " -> " << newComp << std::endl;
3253 }
3254 else if (newComp == opt->getBestCompactness()){
3255 float newUntie = (this->*untieFunct)();
3256 tolog("Prev untie: " + toString(untie) + ", new untie: " + toString(newUntie) + "\n");
3257 opt->setUntie();
3258 if (newUntie > untie){
3259 swapCoords(i, candidate);
3260 tolog("Did not swap on untie\n");
3261 }
3262 }
3263 else{
3264 swapCoords(i, candidate);
3265 }
3266 }
3267 }
3268 }
3269 opt->next();
3270 if (opt->getCounter() >= circles.size()){
3271 opt->endCycle();
3272 }
3273 }
3274 return opt->getBestCompactness();
3275 }

3277 UINT outCrosses(optimizationStep *opt, bool logit = false){
3278 UINT candidate = furthestPoint();
3279 fixTopology();
3280 UINT bestCross = countCrossings();
3281 for (UINT i = 0; i < circles.size(); i++){
3282 if (i != candidate){
3283 swapCoords(i, candidate);
3284 fixTopology();
3285 if (checkTopol()){
3286 swapCoords(i, candidate);
3287 }
3288 else{
3289 UINT newCross = countCrossings();
3290 if (newCross < bestCross){
3291 bestCross = newCross;
3292 tolog("Swapping " + toString(i) + " with " + toString(candidate) + "\n");
3293 }
3294 else{
3295 swapCoords(i, candidate);
3296 }
3297 }
3298 }
3299 }
3300 return bestCross;
3301 }

3344 point spring(point &p0, point &p1, float dampen = 0, float springK = -1)
3345 {
3346 if (springK < 0){
3347 springK = blSettings.sk;
3348 }
3349 point result;
3350 float dx = p1.x - p0.x;
3351 float dy = p1.y - p0.y;
3352 result.fx = springK * dx;
3353 result.fy = springK * dy;
3354 p0.fx += result.fx - dampen * p0.vx * p0.vx * p0.vx;
3355 p1.fx -= result.fx + dampen * p1.vx * p1.vx * p1.vx;
3356 p0.fy += result.fy - dampen * p0.vy * p0.vy * p0.vy;
3357 p1.fy -= result.fy + dampen * p1.vy * p1.vy * p1.vy;
3358 return result;
3359 }

3498 float dy;

3502 zero.fy = 0;

3572 point rope(point &circ, point &p0, point &p1)
3573 {
3574 float a, b;
3575 float d;
3576 point result;
3577 point zero;
3578 point virt;
3579 float d0, d1;
3580 a = (p1.y - p0.y)/(p1.x - p0.x);
3581 b = p0.y - a * p0.x;
3582 virt.x = ((circ.x + a*circ.y - a * b)/(a*a + 1));
3583 virt.y = (a * circ.x + a*a*circ.y + b)/(a*a + 1);
3584 d0 = distance(p0.x, p0.y, virt.x, virt.y) /
3585 distance(p0.x, p0.y, p1.x, p1.y);
3586 d1 = distance(p1.x, p1.y, virt.x, virt.y) /
3587 distance(p0.x, p0.y, p1.x, p1.y);
3588 float td = d0 + d1;
3589 float rd = d0 / td;
3590 virt.vx = p0.vx + (p1.vx-p0.vx) * rd;
3591 virt.fx = p0.fx + (p1.fx-p0.fx) * rd;
3592 virt.vy = p0.vy + (p1.vy-p0.vy) * rd;
3593 virt.fy = p0.fy + (p1.fy-p0.fy) * rd;
3594 virt.mass = p0.mass;
3595 d = distance(circ.x, circ.y, virt.x, virt.y);
3596 if (d < circ.radius && isInside(p0, p1, virt))
3597 {
3598 result = contact(circ, virt);
3599 p0.fx = d1 * virt.fx * rd;
3600 p0.fy = d1 * virt.fy * rd;
3601 p1.fx = d0 * virt.fx * rd;
3602 p1.fy = d0 * virt.fy * rd;
3603 //attention(p0.x, p0.y, p0.x+1e-3*p0.fx, p0.y+1e-3*p0.fy);
3604 //attention(p1.x, p1.y, p1.x+1e-3*p1.fx, p1.y+1e-3*p1.fy);
3605 //Sleep(100);
3606 return result;
3607 }
3608 else
3609 {
3610 return zero;
3611 }
3612 }

3841 int l = prevPoint(i, k);

3847 bl[i][j].y = (bl[i][k].y + bl[i][m].y) / 2;

3849 bl[i][k].y = (bl[i][l].y + bl[i][j].y) / 2;

3851 if (bl[i][m].cancelForce == false && bl[i][n].cancelForce == false){
3852 bl[i][j].x = (bl[i][k].x + bl[i][m].x) / 2;
3853 bl[i][j].y = (bl[i][k].y + bl[i][m].y) / 2;
3854 bl[i][m].x = (bl[i][n].x + bl[i][j].x) / 2;
3855 bl[i][m].y = (bl[i][n].y + bl[i][j].y) / 2;
3856 }
3857 }
3858 }

3862 int closestToSurf(UINT i, UINT j){
3863 // Get the closest circle to a line point
3864 UINT result = 0;
3865 point P = bl[i][j];
3866 while (circles[result].radius == 0 && result < circles.size()){
3867 result++;
3868 }
3869 float mindist = distance(P.x, P.y, circles[result].x, circles[result].y) - circles[result].radius;
3870 UINT k = result;
3871 while (k < circles.size()){
3872 float dst = distance(P.x, P.y, circles[k].x, circles[k].y) - circles[k].radius;
3873 if (dst < mindist){
3874 mindist = dst;
3875 result = circles[k].n;
3876 }
3877 k++;
3878 }
3879 return result;
3880 }

3949 P.vx *= maxv/f;

3955 void limitForce(point &P, float maxf)

3959 if (f > maxf*maxf)
3960 {
3961 f = sqrt(f);
3962 P.fx *= maxf/f;
3963 P.fy *= maxf/f;
3964 }
3965 }

4297 point getCross(point p1, point p2, point p3, point p4){
4298 point result;
4299 if (std::max(p1.x, p2.x) >= std::min(p3.x, p4.x) &&
4300 std::max(p1.y, p2.y) >= std::min(p3.y, p4.y) &&
4301 std::min(p1.x, p2.x) <= std::max(p3.x, p4.x) &&
4302 std::min(p1.y, p2.y) <= std::max(p3.y, p4.y)){
4303 if (p2.x == p1.x){
4304 result.x = p1.x;
4305 result.y = p3.y + (result.x - p3.x) * (p4.y - p3.y) / (p4.x - p3.x);
4306 }
4307 else if (p4.x == p3.x){
4308 result.x = p3.x;
4309 result.y = p1.y + (result.x - p1.x) * (p2.y - p1.y) / (p2.x - p1.x);
4310 }
4311 else{
4312 float m1 = (p2.y - p1.y) / (p2.x - p1.x);
4313 float m3 = (p4.y - p3.y) / (p4.x - p3.x);
4314 result.x = (p3.y - m3 * p3.x - p1.y + m1 * p1.x) / (m1 - m3);
4315 result.y = p1.y + m1 * (result.x - p1.x);
4316 }
4317 }
4318 return result;
4319 }
4320
4332 crossResult cross(point p1, point p2, point p3, point p4){
4333 crossResult result = doesnotcross;
4334 if (std::max(p1.x, p2.x) >= std::min(p3.x, p4.x) &&
4335 std::max(p1.y, p2.y) >= std::min(p3.y, p4.y) &&
4336 std::min(p1.x, p2.x) <= std::max(p3.x, p4.x) &&
4337 std::min(p1.y, p2.y) <= std::max(p3.y, p4.y)){
4338 if (p1 == p3 || p2 == p3){
4339 return crosses;
4340 }
4341 if (p2 == p4 || p1 == p4){
4342 return doesnotcross;
4343 }
4344 tangent t1 = tangent(p1, p3);
4345 tangent t2 = tangent(p3, p2);
4346 tangent t3 = tangent(p2, p4);
4347 tangent t4 = tangent(p4, p1);
4348 t2.rotate(t1);
4349 t3.rotate(t1);
4350 t4.rotate(t1);
4351 tangent tz = tangent(-1, 0);
4352 if (t2 == tz){
4353 result = doesnotcross;
4354 }
4355 else if (t3 == t4){
4356 result = cont;
4357 }
4358 else{
4359 if (((t2 <= t3) && (t3 <= t4)) ||
4360 ((t3 <= t2) && (t4 <= t3))){
4361 result = crosses;
4362 }
4363 }
4364 //blSettings.cycleInfo += "Tangents: \n" + t1.croack() + t2.croack() + t3.croack() + t4.croack();
4365 }
4366 return result;
4367 }

4537UINT getRelationships(UINT o, UINT t){
4538 UINT i = std::min(o, t);
4539 UINT j = std::max(o, t);
4540 if (i == j){
4541 return 0;
4542 }
4543 UINT r = 0;
4544 UINT N = circles.size();
4545 i++;
4546 UINT row = ((2*i-2) * N - i * i + i) / 2;
4547 r = row + j - i;
4548 return relationships[r];
4549}

4643 float minCircDist(){
4644 UINT flg = twoPow(ngroups) - 1;
4645 groupIterator ci(circles, 0, 0, flg);
4646 UINT fst = ci.val();
4647 UINT scnd = ci.nxt();
4648 float r = sqDistance(circles[fst], circles[scnd]);
4649 ci = groupIterator(circles, 0, 0, flg);
4650 groupIterator ci2(circles, 0, 0, flg);
4651 while (!ci.isFinished()){
4652 UINT v = ci.val();
4653 ci2.reset(v);
4654 while (!ci2.isFinished()){
4655 UINT w = ci2.nxt();
4656 if (v != w){
4657 float nr = sqDistance(circles[v], circles[w]);
4658 if (nr < r){
4659 r = nr;
4660 }
4661 }
4662 }
4663 ci.nxt();
4664 }
4665
4666 float result = sqrt(r);
4667 return result;
4668 }

4714 void centerScene(){

4718 float ymin = internalScale.minY();
4719 float deltax = (xmax + xmin) / 2;
4720 float deltay = (ymax + ymin) / 2;
4721 for (UINT i = 0; i < bl.size(); i++){
4722 for (UINT j = 0; j < bl[i].size(); j++){
4723 bl[i][j].x -= deltax;

4725 internalScale.addToScale(bl[i][j]);

4738 void rotateScene(float alpha){

4741 float sina = std::sin(alpha);

4748 t.x = cosa * bl[i][j].x + sina * (bl[i][j].y);
4749 t.y = -sina * bl[i][j].x + cosa * (bl[i][j].y);

4752 }

4755 t.x = cosa * circles[i].x + sina * (circles[i].y);
4756 t.y = -sina * circles[i].x + cosa * (circles[i].y);
4757 newcirc.push_back(t);
4758 }

4764 void attachScene(){

4780 lp = j;

4842 void scSolve(){
4843 blSettings.dt = tosolve.solve(blSettings.dt, resetV);
4844 bool incorrect = checkTopol();
4845 while (incorrect){
4846 restorePrevState();
4847 evaluation.init();
4848 //tolog(_L_ + "Bad topol\n");
4849 udt.report();
4850 if (blSettings.dt < blSettings.mindt){
4851 tolog(_L_ + "Cannot solve topol problems\n");
4852 toSVG();
4853 error = true;
4854 errorMessage = "Cannot solve topol problems\n";
4855 }
4856 blSettings.dt = udt.cdt();
4857 //tolog(_L_ + "Bad topol: " + toString(udt.cdt()) + "\n");
4858 tosolve.solve(blSettings.dt, resetV);
4859 incorrect = checkTopol();
4860 }
4861 if (blCounter == 0){
4862 setPrevState();
4863 }
4864 if (deciderCounter.isMax()){
4865 setPrevState();
4866 udt.poke();
4867 blSettings.dt = udt.cdt();
4868 }
4869 if (blSettings.optimize && keepDistCounter.isMax()){
4870 keepDist(avgStartDist);
4871 if (checkTopol()){
4872 writeSVG("error.svg");
4873 listOutsiders();
4874 tolog(_L_ + "Break on KeepDist\n");
4875 restorePrevState();
4876 }
4877 else{
4878 setSecureState();
4879 }
4880 }
4881 resetScale();
4882 resetCircleRadius();
4883 float d = (this->*currentMeasure)();
4884 evaluation.add(d);
4885 float mfsq = std::log10(tosolve.getMaxFsq());
4886 float mvsq = std::log10(tosolve.getMaxVsq());
4887 float mdsq = std::log10(tosolve.getMaxDsq());
4888 displayFloat("EVALUATE", d);
4889 displayFloat("LASTEVALUATE", evaluation.viewLastComp());
4890 if (blSettings.optimize){
4891 if (evaluation.keepState() && sensible()){
4892 setBestSoFar();
4893 }
4894 }
4895 displayFloat("DT", blSettings.dt);
4896 displayFloat("SIMTIME", tosolve.simTime());
4897 //displayFloat("MAXV", mvsq);
4898 //displayFloat("MAXF", mfsq);
4899 displayUINT("COUNTER", evaluation.viewCounter());
4900 displayUINT("CANFINISH", evaluation.viewCanFinish());
4901 displayUINT("CWI", evaluation.viewCyclesWithoutImprovement());
4902 //displayUINT("DECIDER", deciderCounter);
4903 blCounter++;
4904 deciderCounter++;
4905 keepDistCounter++;
4906 blSettings.ncycles++;
4907 }

4992 void setCoords(std::string dataFile){
4993 std::ifstream vFile;
4994 vFile.open(dataFile.c_str());
4995 UINT ncI = 0;
4996 if (vFile.good() == true){
4997 bl.clear();
4998 savedState.bl_secure.clear();
4999 savedState.bl_old10.clear();
5000 std::string line;
5001 getline(vFile, line); // _F
5002 getline(vFile, line); // ncyclesInterrupted or _L
5003 if (line != "_L"){
5004 int c = atoi(line.c_str());
5005 if (c > 0) ncI = (UINT) c;
5006 blSettings.ncyclesInterrupted = ncI;
5007 getline(vFile, line); // _L
5008 }
5009 while (line == "_L" && vFile.eof() == false){
5010 std::vector<point> thisline;
5011 getline(vFile, line); // First x coord
5012 while (line != "_L" && line != "_C" && vFile.eof() == false){
5013 float x = atof(line.c_str());
5014 getline(vFile, line);
5015 float y = atof(line.c_str());
5016 point p;
5017 p.x = x; p.y = y;
5018 internalScale.addToScale(p);
5019 thisline.push_back(p);
5020 getline(vFile, line);
5021 }
5022 bl.push_back(thisline);
5023 }
5024 if (line == "_C"){
5025 getline(vFile, line);
5026 int i = 0;
5027 while (vFile.eof() == false){
5028 float x = atof(line.c_str());
5029 getline(vFile, line);
5030 float y = atof(line.c_str());
5031 getline(vFile, line);
5032 float r = atof(line.c_str());
5033 getline(vFile, line);
5034 circles[i].x = x; circles[i].y = y; circles[i].radius = r;
5035 i++;
5036 }
5037 }
5038 }

5081 const std::string vformat(const char * const zcFormat, ...) {
5082
5083 // initialize use of the variable argument array
5084 va_list vaArgs;
5085 va_start(vaArgs, zcFormat);
5086
5087 // reliably acquire the size
5088 // from a copy of the variable argument array
5089 // and a functionally reliable call to mock the formatting
5090 va_list vaArgsCopy;
5091 va_copy(vaArgsCopy, vaArgs);
5092 const int iLen = std::vsnprintf(NULL, 0, zcFormat, vaArgsCopy);
5093 va_end(vaArgsCopy);
5094
5095 // return a formatted string without risking memory mismanagement
5096 // and without assuming any compiler or platform specific behavior
5097 std::vector<char> zc(iLen + 1);
5098 std::vsnprintf(zc.data(), zc.size(), zcFormat, vaArgs);
5099 va_end(vaArgs);
5100 return std::string(zc.data(), iLen);
5101 }

5551 //float md = minDist;

5555 for (UINT i = 0; i < bl.size(); i++){

5560 bl[i][j].x = q[0].x;

5566 bl[i][j].y = q[0].y;

5576 if (d < (md)){

5578 counter++;
5579 //tolog("Distance between " + toString(lastConserved) + " and " +

5589 //tolog("Using minCircScreenRadius " + toString(md) + "\n");

5591 std::vector<point> rb;

5611 void interpolateToDist(float pDist){
5612 if (pDist <= 0){
5613 pDist = 1;
5614 }
5615
5616 for (UINT i = 0; i < bl.size(); i++){
5617 std::vector<point>tempbl;
5618 float pointDist = pDist;
5619 if (bl[i].size() < 5){
5620 pointDist = pDist / 10;
5621 }
5622 for(UINT j = 0; j < bl[i].size(); j++){
5623 point current = bl[i][j];
5624 point nxt = bl[i][nextPoint(i, j)];
5625 float d = distance(current.x, current.y, nxt.x, nxt.y);
5626 UINT interpoints = ceil(d / pointDist);
5627 if (interpoints == 0)
5628 interpoints = 1;
5629 float dx = (float)(nxt.x - current.x);
5630 dx = dx / interpoints;
5631 float dy = (float)(nxt.y - current.y);
5632 dy = dy / interpoints;
5633 //tolog(toString(__LINE__) + "\n" + "Current: " + current.croack());
5634 for (UINT k = 0; k < interpoints; k++){
5635 point tempPoint;
5636 tempPoint.x = current.x + (k * dx);
5637 tempPoint.y = current.y + (k * dy);
5638 tempPoint.mass = POINT_MASS;
5639 //tolog(toString(__LINE__) + "\n" + "Interp: " + tempPoint.croack());
5640 tempbl.push_back(tempPoint);
5641 }
5642 //tolog(toString(__LINE__) + "\n" + "Next: " + nxt.croack());
5643 }
5644 bl[i] = tempbl;
5645 }
5646 avgStartDist = pDist;
5647 attachScene();
5648 }
5649
5650 void interpolate(UINT npoints)
5651 {
5652 UINT i, j, k;
5653 float dx, dy;
5654 float perim;
5655 float segment;
5656 UINT interpoints;
5657 point startPoint;
5658 point endPoint;
5659 point tempPoint;
5660 std::vector<point> tempv;
5661 std::vector<std::vector<point> > tempbl;
5662 npoints += (UINT) bl[0].size();
5663 for (i = 0; i < bl.size(); i++)
5664 {
5665 perim = perimeter(bl[i], true);
5666 nPointsMin = (UINT) (perim / bl.size());
5667 startPoint = bl[i][bl[i].size()-1];
5668 avgStartDist = perim / npoints;
5669 for (j = 0; j < bl[i].size(); j++)
5670 {
5671 endPoint = bl[i][j];
5672 segment = distance(startPoint.x, startPoint.y,
5673 endPoint.x, endPoint.y);
5674 interpoints = (int)(segment / avgStartDist);
5675 if (interpoints == 0)
5676 interpoints = 1;
5677 dx = (float)(endPoint.x - startPoint.x);
5678 dx = dx / interpoints;
5679 dy = (float)(endPoint.y - startPoint.y);
5680 dy = dy / interpoints;
5681 for (k = 0; k < interpoints; k++)
5682 {
5683 tempPoint.x = startPoint.x + (k * dx);
5684 tempPoint.y = startPoint.y + (k * dy);
5685 tempPoint.mass = POINT_MASS;
5686 tempv.push_back(tempPoint);
5687 }
5688 startPoint = endPoint;
5689 }
5690 tempbl.push_back(tempv);
5691 tempv.clear();
5692 }
5693 bl.clear();
5694 bl = tempbl;
5695 initOlds();
5696 attachScene();
5697 }

5720 std::string getSignature(){
5721 std::stringstream result;
5722 result << seed << ";";
5723 result << ngroups << ";";
5724 for (UINT i = 0; i < groups.size(); i++){
5725 result << groups[i] << ";";
5726 }
5727 std::vector<float> origs;
5728 origs.assign((1 << ngroups), 0);
5729 for (UINT j = 0; j < circles.size(); j++){
5730 UINT n = circles[j].n;
5731 origs[n] = circles[j].orig;
5732 }
5733 for (UINT i = 0; i < origs.size(); i++){
5734 result << origs[i] << ";";
5735 }
5736 return result.str();
5737 }

5744 void loadSignature(std::string sig){
5745 bl.clear();
5746 circles.clear();
5747 circRadii.clear();
5748 fromSignature = true;
5749 std::vector<std::string> rgroups;
5750 std::vector<std::string> tl;
5751 splitString nums(sig, ';');
5752 std::string nxt;
5753 nxt = purgeLetters(nums.next());
5754 seed = atoi(nxt.c_str());
5755 nxt = purgeLetters(nums.next());
5756 UINT ng = atoi(nxt.c_str());
5757 if (ng > 0){
5758 tl.assign((1 << ng), "");
5759 for (UINT j = 0; j < ng; j++){
5760 nxt = nums.next();

5824 bool setStep(UINT stepNumber = 0){
5825 bool result = true;
5826 if (error){
5827 std::cout << errorMessage << std::endl;
5828 return false;
5829 }
5830 if (stepNumber == attract){
5831 // Start by saving signature
5832 signature = getSignature();
5833 //
5834 refreshScreen.setLimits(1,1);
5835 resetV = false;
5836 setCheckTopol(false);
5837 }
5838 else if (stepNumber == disperse){
5839 setCheckTopol(false);
5840 }
5841 else if (stepNumber == minimizeCompactness){
5842 setFixedCircles(false);
5843 setCheckTopol(true);
5844 resetOptimize();
5845 fixTopology();
5846 oc.maxOutCount = 10;
5847 oc.outCount = 0;
5848 oc.optVal = compactness();
5849 optStep.init(oc.optVal);
5850 oc.optVal = outCompactness(&optStep, &borderLine::furthestPoint,
5851 &borderLine::compactness, &borderLine::countCrossings);
5852 }
5853 else if (stepNumber == minimizeCrossings){
5854 resetOptimize();
5855 fixTopology();
5856 oc.maxOutCount = 10;
5857 oc.outCount = 0;
5858 oc.optVal = countCrossings();
5859 optStep.init(oc.optVal);
5860 oc.optVal = outCompactness(&optStep, &borderLine::crossestPoint,
5861 &borderLine::countCrossings, &borderLine::compactness);
5862 }
5863 else if (stepNumber == contract){
5864 udt.init(1e-4, 0.01);
5865 resetOptimize();
5866 fixTopology();
5867 setCheckTopol(true);
5868 evaluation.init();
5869 evaluation.setConstants(50, 50);
5870 if (checkTopol() == false){
5871 interpolateToDist(2 * minCircDist());
5872 setPrevState();
5873 setSecureState();
5874 }
5875 else{
5876 listOutsiders();
5877 std::ofstream result;
5878 fileText svgfile = toSVG();
5879 result.open("error.svg");
5880 result.write(svgfile.getText().c_str(), svgfile.getText().size());
5881 result.close();
5882 error = true;
5883 errorMessage = "Could not fix topology at start\n";
5884 }
5885 resetTimer();
5886 attachScene();
5887 scFriction(100);
5888 scD(1e2);
5889 scG(1e-1);
5890 scSpringK(1e4);
5891 scGhostGrav(false);
5892 getBestSoFar();
5893 }
5894 else if (stepNumber == refineCircles){
5895 resetTimer();
5896 resetOptimize();
5897 evaluation.init();
5898 evaluation.setConstants(10, 50);
5899 float d = getEmbellishDist(2);
5900 interpolateToDist(d);
5901 setGravityPartitions();
5902 scSpringK(1e4);
5903 scFriction(1000);
5904 scG(1e-1);
5905 scD(1e2);
5906 scGhostGrav(true);
5907 getBestSoFar();
5908 }
5909 else if (stepNumber == embellishLines){
5910 if (checkTopol() == true){
5911 restorePrevState();
5912 }
5913 resetTimer();
5914 resetOptimize();
5915 evaluation.init();
5916 evaluation.setConstants(10, 0, 1.01, 30);
5917 startRefiningSteps();
5918 resetTimer();
5919 float d = getEmbellishDist(0.4);
5920 interpolateToDist(d);
5921 setGravityPartitions();
5922 this->currentMeasure = &borderLine::getArea;
5923 resetV = true;
5924 scG(2e-1);
5925 scD(50);
5926 scSpringK(1e4);
5927 scFriction(500);
5928 oc.maxOutCount = 70;
5929 oc.outCount = 0;
5930 oc.optVal = 0;
5931 setPrevState();
5932 setSecureState();
5933 }
5934 else{
5935 result = false;
5936 }
5937 return result;
5938 }
5939 bool setCycle(UINT stepNumber = 0){
5940 dataDisplay.clear();
5941 displayUINT("STEP", stepNumber);
5942 if (error){
5943 return false;
5944 }
5945 bool result = true;
5946 if (stepNumber == attract){
5947 setForcesFirstStep();
5948 solve();
5949 }
5950 else if (stepNumber == disperse){
5951 setForcesSecondStep();
5952 setContacts(false, true, 3*maxRad()*AIR);
5953 solve(true);
5954 }
5955 else if (stepNumber == minimizeCompactness){
5956 float thisOut = outCompactness(&optStep, &borderLine::furthestPoint,
5957 &borderLine::compactness, &borderLine::countCrossings);
5958 if (optStep.hasEnded()){
5959 if (thisOut < oc.optVal){
5960 oc.optVal = thisOut;
5961 oc.outCount = 0;
5962 //showCrossings();
5963 }
5964 else{
5965 oc.outCount = oc.outCount + 1;
5966 tolog("Outcount: " + toString(oc.outCount) + "\n");
5967 }
5968 //fixTopology();
5969 }
5970 }
5971 else if (stepNumber == minimizeCrossings){
5972 float thisCross = outCompactness(&optStep, &borderLine::crossestPoint,
5973 &borderLine::countCrossings, &borderLine::compactness);
5974 if (optStep.hasEnded()){
5975 if (thisCross < oc.optVal){
5976 oc.optVal = thisCross;
5977 oc.outCount = 0;
5978 //showCrossings();
5979 }
5980 else{
5981 oc.outCount = oc.outCount + 1;
5982 tolog("Outcount: " + toString(oc.outCount) + "\n");
5983 }
5984 //fixTopology();
5985 }
5986 }
5987 else if (stepNumber == contract || stepNumber == refineCircles){
5988 scSolve();
5989 /*if (tosolve.getDebugSignal()){
5990 writeSVG();
5991 exit(0);
5992 }*/
5993 }
5994 else if (stepNumber == embellishLines){
5995 scSolve();
5996 oc.outCount++;
5997 }
5998 else{
5999 result = false;
6000 }
6001 return result;
6002 }
6003 bool isStepFinished(UINT stepNumber = 0){
6004 bool result = false;
6005 if (stepNumber == attract){
6006 float tc = maxCircleVsq;
6007 if (tc > 0 && tc < 1e-2){
6008 result = true;
6009 }
6010 }
6011 else if (stepNumber == disperse){
6012 if (minCircDist() > (2*maxRad()*AIR)){
6013 result = true;
6014 }
6015 }
6016 else if (stepNumber == minimizeCompactness || stepNumber == minimizeCrossings){
6017 if (oc.outCount > oc.maxOutCount){
6018 result = true;
6019 }
6020 }
6021 else if (stepNumber == contract || stepNumber == refineCircles){
6022 result = isSimulationComplete();
6023 }
6024 else if (stepNumber == embellishLines){
6025 result = isSimulationComplete();
6026 if (result){
6027 blSettings.smoothSVG = true;
6028 currentStep = 1;
6029 }
6030 //if (getMaxVsq() > 1e-7){
6031 // result = false;
6032 //}
6033 }
6034 refreshScreen++;
6035 return result;
6036 }
6037 bool refresh(){
6038 return refreshScreen.isMax();
6039 }

6043 bool simulate(int maxRel = 0){
6044 restart_log();
6045 for (UINT step = currentStep; step < 8; step++){
6046 bool bQuit = false;
6047 std::cout << "Step " << step << std::endl;
6048 bool success = setStep(step);
6049 if (!success) return false;
6050 while (!bQuit){
6051 setCycle(step);
6052 if (err()){
6053 std::cout << errorMessage << std::endl;
6054 bQuit = true;
6055 }
6056 if (refreshScreen.isMax()) writeSVG();
6057 if (isStepFinished(step)){
6058 bQuit = true;
6059 }
6060 }
6061 }
6062 return true;
6063 }
